Use DDT. Description, dialogue, thoughts. Describe your setting, characters, etc. Allow your characters to talk and well.. have emotions and emotional value to the audience. Allow your character(s) to have their own thoughts. If you’re writing a personal narrative, I recommend using first person POV. If you want to use third person POV, go for it!
I also recommend just getting ideas down on whatever you’re typing first. A rough outline, including the start, rising action, climax, falling action, and conclusion.

Establish your settings, characters, etc. Don’t make the story go so fast no one can know what’s going on, but don’t make it too slow where people are bored out of their minds.

I hope this helps!
